Class Palette

java.lang.Object
net.tessel.fx.Palette
public final class Palette extends Object
The colors of a Tessel theme. The values match the Tessel.NET / Tessel4J design tokens. Obtain the active palette with Tessel.palette(); the same colors are available to style sheets as the looked-up colors -tsl-background, -tsl-surface, -tsl-accent, ...
